item.title: Useful Git Commands
item.description:
Quick git commands I keep forgetting:

# Undo last commit (keep changes)
git reset --soft HEAD~1

# Stash changes
git stash push -m "work in progress"

# Interactive rebase
git rebase -i HEAD~5
